# Alec

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Last P28](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Alec is described as having lovely, curly, black hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Alec possesses a good-tempered disposition. He is also noted for having lovely, curly black hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## History

When John Douglas's mother passed away during Anne's stay in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), Alec fetched [Janet](../character/janet.md). Shortly after, John arrived to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and revealed that his late mother had forced him to delay his marriage until her death.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are romantic rivals who are both competing for the affections of [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). They both act as suitors seeking her hand in marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)_

- Rival of — suitors competing for Phil Gordon's hand  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec is romantically involved with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) as one of her suitors. He accompanies her during her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), where she pursues personal matters alongside her companions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), +4 more_
